reasons: The cited grant in p0149 is expressly 'revocable' and names only Customer, with no affiliate/contractor coverage and no transfer right — this correctly reads as a deviation from the LICENSE preferred position and sits near the walk-away (at-will revocation plus excluded affiliates/contractors).

The redline reaches the playbook position: it adds 'its Affiliates, and its Subcontractors acting on Customer's behalf', deletes 'revocable', makes the licence irrevocable for the term subject only to termination for uncured material breach (Section 3.3), and confirms transfer to a successor under a permitted Section 14.10 assignment — matching each element of the redline guidance.

The failed 'minimal edit' check (0.774 changed-character ratio) is expected here: the rule requires rewriting the single grant sentence to add parties, strike revocability, and insert irrevocability/successor language; the operative use restriction and the anti-copying covenant are preserved.
Comment is accurate, in-house tone, states the playbook position and offers the affiliates-on-written-notice fallback.
